Inclusion Criteria:
  -  All birth more than 37 weeks of amenorrhea at the maternity ward of the hospital Femme-Mère-Enfant
  -  from 1st of january 2000 to 31 december 2016
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Infants born  [AND] out of the hospital and secondarily hospitalized in the hospital Femme-Mère-Enfant
  -  Children  [AND] with congenital anomalies  [OR] or without valid arterial  [OR] and venous umbilical cord samples
